followUpQuestions.label: For a qualified technician: record the result shown by the cited manual's service-mode Step 3 (RC sensor). Use the manual for the model-specific sequence; do not perform voltage tests from this prompt.

For a qualified technician: record the result shown by the cited manual's service-mode Step 1 (FC sensor). Use the manual for the model-specific sequence; do not perform voltage tests from this prompt.

branches.cause: The cited service-mode checks flagged both RC and FC sensor circuits. This does not identify whether a sensor or its wiring is the cause.
branches.limitation: This is a circuit indication only. Confirm the exact unit configuration and follow its Tech Sheet before replacing parts.
steps: Record both displayed results and the exact model suffix.
Use the unit's Tech Sheet to distinguish the sensor from its harness. Disconnect power before servicing and restore all panels before operation.

branches.cause: The cited service-mode Step 3 flagged the RC sensor circuit open or short. This does not prove the sensor itself has failed.
branches.limitation: Confirm the exact unit configuration and follow its Tech Sheet before replacing parts.
steps: Record the displayed result and the exact model suffix.
Use the unit's Tech Sheet to distinguish the sensor from its harness. Disconnect power before servicing and restore all panels before operation.

branches.cause: The cited service-mode Step 1 flagged the FC sensor circuit open or short. This does not prove the sensor itself has failed.
branches.limitation: Confirm the exact unit configuration and follow its Tech Sheet before replacing parts.
steps: Record the displayed result and the exact model suffix.
Use the unit's Tech Sheet to distinguish the sensor from its harness. Disconnect power before servicing and restore all panels before operation.

fallback.cause: These observations do not establish a failed component. The sensor checks did not report an open or short circuit, or usable results were not recorded.
fallback.limitation: The cited manual does not provide a warm-symptom cause from these observations alone. No cooling-system or electrical fault is confirmed.
steps: Keep the recorded compartment readings with the case.
Continue only with the Tech Sheet supplied for the exact unit. Its service manual says the wiring diagram is typical and directs technicians to the product Tech Sheet.
